transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you're aware, Line 6 is scheduled to produce 1,400 medical-device housings this week, but our normally approved resin R-17 is temporarily unavailable. We do have an alternate medical-grade resin, R-22, available for a controlled run on Line 6. Before I issue the engineering authorization to proceed, I need to hear from each of you on any constraints. Quality, process engineering, regulatory affairs, and production planning — please walk me through any concerns or conditions you have so I can make a fully informed authorization decision.
